modern: Neither the labour which the hand does nor that of the foot is contrary to nature, so long as the foot does the foot’s work and the hand the hand’s. So then neither is a man’s labour, to him as a man, contrary to nature, so long as it does the things of a man. And if the labour is not contrary to his nature, neither is it an evil to him.
